Reproduce: uv run --script .wisc/scripts/generate-downstream-skillsight-average.py
Selection: Model=Qwen3.5 4B, Retriever=SkillSight, Dataset=Average, seven remaining paper methods.\nReferences: Retriever=None, Dataset=Average, LLM Direct and LLM Oracle.
Excluded newer CSV methods: Progressive Disclosure.
Aggregation: sum(Correct)/sum(n_tasks) across six datasets, 748 tasks per selected method.
The CSV Average Accuracy (six decimals) is plotted without additional averaging.
Checked each constituent and aggregate accuracy against integer counts within 0.0000005; checked ten means against actual paper cells rounded to three decimals.
No error bars: the supplied CSV has no uncertainty estimates.
No run-level re-audit or inference performed.
The paper provenance records the refreshed source hash.

Inherited paper-table provenance:
Downstream performance

Source: ../BayesGSI/tables/downstream_performance/results.csv
Source SHA256: 3b3ec768cd176ac7950fc90ac3f50ff65a115f4cf0b8b0dd3dd0928cad022690
Source rows: 182; selected rows: 161.
Selection: all source rows
Metrics: Accuracy
Exact source Model/Retriever/Method/Dataset labels are preserved; no aliases.
Scores are fractions, not percentages. Table cells use three decimals; ranking uses unrounded values.
Missing table values are ---; missing plotted values fail closed, never imputed.
Success Rate is source Accuracy, a fraction. The average is computed over all instances. Average is supplied pooled Correct/n_tasks, using summed counts across datasets. CSV methods do not match input_runs.json.
Dataset columns group their metrics beneath each dataset header. Retrieval and reranking shows only source Dataset=Average rows, with five recall metrics (R@1, R@5, R@10, R@25, R@50) beneath retriever-only group headings, without Model or Retriever columns; no additional averaging is performed.
Bold best and underlined second distinct values are scoped to model/retriever/dataset/metric for dataset-grouped tables and model/retriever/metric for overall recall; ties share markers. PDF is actual generated TeX. Multi-page PNG tiles all PDF pages at 300 DPI.

Regenerate from any working directory:
  uv run --script paper/tables/downstream_performance/generate.py
Optional fixture arguments: --source /path/results.csv --output /path/output
Shared selection/provenance manifest: paper/artifact_manifest.json.

changes.before: \caption{Average recall under progressively smaller ranked cutoffs, with equal weights across BM25, Vector, and SkillSight. The baseline curve averages the three retrievers' native baselines; every other curve averages the corresponding method across retrievers. Curves show absolute Recall@k, not normalized loss, at equally spaced categorical cutoffs 50, 25, 10, 5, and 1. Each retriever's scores are source task-weighted averages over 748 test tasks; no uncertainty is estimated. Recall retention at cutoff 5 is 100 times Recall@5/Recall@50, computed separately for each retriever and then averaged equally across retrievers. It is not mean per-task retention or a count of retained skills. Skill-Pro ranks selected candidates first, then by retrieval score and original rank; SkillRouter uses its full 50-candidate reranking, not its top-1 selected set. Other archived rankings are retained; differing candidate pools are not a controlled shared-candidate comparison. Vector RouterBSI uses final iteration 10 from the fixed run, which is completed\_noncanonical (reportable=false); these results are analysis-only.}

Downstream performance

Source: ../BayesGSI/tables/downstream_performance/results.csv
Source SHA256: 3b3ec768cd176ac7950fc90ac3f50ff65a115f4cf0b8b0dd3dd0928cad022690
Source rows: 182; selected rows: 161.
Selection: all source rows
Metrics: Accuracy
Exact source Model/Retriever/Method/Dataset labels are preserved; no aliases.
Scores are fractions, not percentages. Table cells use three decimals; ranking uses unrounded values.
Missing table values are ---; missing plotted values fail closed, never imputed.
Success Rate is source Accuracy, a fraction. The average is computed over all instances. Average is supplied pooled Correct/n_tasks, using summed counts across datasets. CSV methods do not match input_runs.json.
Dataset columns group their metrics beneath each dataset header. Retrieval and reranking shows only source Dataset=Average rows, with five recall metrics (R@1, R@5, R@10, R@25, R@50) beneath retriever-only group headings, without Model or Retriever columns; no additional averaging is performed.
Bold best and underlined second distinct values are scoped to model/retriever/dataset/metric for dataset-grouped tables and model/retriever/metric for overall recall; ties share markers. PDF is actual generated TeX. Multi-page PNG tiles all PDF pages at 300 DPI.

  uv run --script paper/tables/downstream_performance/generate.py

Shared selection/provenance manifest: paper/artifact_manifest.json.
